notes.title: Laika: Aged Through Blood is coming to Nintendo Switch! 🎮🔥
notes.content:
Get ready for an unforgettable journey in this emotional post-apocalyptic Western Motorvania as it arrives on Nintendo Switch for the very first time! 

[b]WATCH THE TEASER TRAILER: [/b]
[previewyoutube=2UoWNET0bRo;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/laika-aged-through-blood-switch/]PRE-ORDER NOW[/url]

Take control of Laika, a fierce warrior out for vengeance, as she rides her motorbike through a haunting, hand-painted world filled with danger and intense combat.

Fight against oppressive forces, unravel the secrets behind a land torn apart by power, betrayal, and heartbreak - and prepare for a story that will stay with you long after the dust settles. 

[b]KEY FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Vehicular combat on a fast and agile motorbike.
[*] A beautiful, hand-painted post-apocalyptic world.
[*] A deep story about a mother-daughter relationship, vengeance, and loss.
[*] Epic boss battles and loads of missions.
[*] Ambient and haunting soundtrack.
[/list]

notes.title: A massive "thank you" from all of us behind Laika: Aged Through Blood! ❤️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41486218/b941a2dae3b8c7626a582c19c35eb576b726ddde.jpg[/img]

Greetings, bikers!

[b]We've been journeying through the Wastelands for (almost) a week![/b] Can you believe it? Time flies when you're out there doing backflips and battling an entire invading army.

We wanted to take a moment to shout out a massive [u][b]THANK YOU[/b][/u] from everyone at Brainwash Gang and Headup for such an awesome response [b]and for your support[/b]! ːsteamhappyː

We are listening to your feedback, and we're working hard to address all the issues that could have only come up with such a massive amount of active players. So, an additional thanks to everyone of you who spent some time reporting bugs on our [url=https://discord.gg/RH5qcunBc6][b]Discord server[/b][/url] and the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1796220][b]Steam forums[/b][/url]!

Now, let's get down to business. We've been deploying bug-fixing patches almost every day, fixing video codec issues, software incompatibilities, and gameplay bugs (and typos!). But there is still work to do!

[b]Here's what we're up to right now:[/b]
[list][*] Discussing all your feedback!
[*] Various gameplay bugs.
[*] Backup system to avoid loss of progress after crashes.
[*] Expanded input binding.
[*] More settings and accessibility options.
[*] Crash hunting! (we need your help with this!)[/list]
See you in the Wastelands!
Brainwash Gang

[b]PS:[/b] Please leave a review if you haven't done yet, this really helps us! Let's get to [u][b]500[/b][/u]! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Laika: Aged Through Blood Update 1.0.3 is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41486218/371ee3fbd0292335c7556111380b69bb7976fc05.jpg[/img]

Coyote's greetings! 🦊

It's really incredible! Laika has been available for just over 24 hours and we have already received so much feedback from all of you out there! Please keep it coming, as it is highly valuable for us! ❤️

And so we could release the very first [b]update 1.0.3[/b] for [b]Laika: Aged Through Blood[/b] today. The update fixes some bugs and also makes some small changes. This is the complete list:

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list][*] Fix (Softblock): Player can't get back on the bike after hopping off in certain parkings
[*] Fix: Camera is off-centered to the right in some areas of the Mines
[*] Fix: Typos and incorrect button prompts in tutorial boxes
[*] Fix: Destroying a dragged bomb doesn't roll back the hook[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list][*] The game now checks for completed steam achievements when the save is loaded
[*] Lowered default deadzone for right joystick to 0.2
[*] Added cooldown to UI input to improve navigation
[*] Updated credits[/list]
Have a great time with Laika and her trusted motorbike!
Brainwash Gang

notes.title: This is Laika: Aged Through Blood in a Nutshell! 🌰
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41486218/4fc8dd200ff2e274183a2f31169c1a2b64bf7b8d.jpg[/img]

Hey there, friends!

As [b]Laika: Aged Through Blood[/b] will finally release on PC tomorrow, we thought we'd drop a little summary of what you can expect from the game we have worked on for the last years.

We've really enjoyed making the game and are feeling extremely proud of the final result, and are confident that you will have a great time with Laika and her trusted motorbike. Anyways, we think that it's a good idea to lay out the features of [b]Laika: Aged Through Blood[/b] open and honestly, so you know what to expect before spending your hard-earned money.

Here you go, this is [b]Laika: Aged Through Blood[/b] in a nutshell:

[list][*] A single-player, western inspired motorvania set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland that tells the story of a mother coyote warrior who descends on an endless path of vengeance to take back what her people lost
[*] Vehicular Twin-stick shooter combat with 5 different upgradeable weapons, a skill-based power-up system and 6 unique big boss fights
[*] A hand-drawn post-apocalyptic world filled to the brim with strange characters, loads of missions and detailed environments to explore
[*] A deep story about a mother-daughter relationship, vengeance and loss translated to 8 languages.
[*] Around 12-15 hours of gameplay to complete the main storyline
[*] +20 collectible cassettes hidden around the world with Beícoli’s songs to listen to while exploring and shooting
[*] Full mouse + Keyboard, with accessibility features such as auto-aim and the ability to slow down dialogue[/list]
That’s it! That’s [b]Laika: Aged Through Blood[/b]. Should we be lucky enough that you deem it worthy, we really really hope you enjoy playing it as much as we’ve enjoyed making it for you!

See you tomorrow for release, friends!
Brainwash Gang


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1796220/Laika_Aged_Through_Blood/

notes.title: Laika's next Stop on the Road to Release: Steam Next Fest: October 2023! 🔥
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41486218/66ee728a7436d8117de3d72b94f75178fd320398.jpg[/img]

Happy Monday, friends!

Once again, it's about time for the fabulous [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! Until October 16 hundreds of demos are live here on Steam, connected to hundreds of streams, developer specials, and much more. Exciting times for sure, and you definitely don't want to miss this! ːsteamhappyː

Ha ha, and you guessed it already: [b]Laika: Aged Through Blood[/b] is aboard for Steam Next Fest as well! Just scroll down and click the green "Download" button to get your hands on the demo.

And as promised, we updated the demo from the one you might have played already. And that's what's coming with the new demo:
[list][*] Performance optimisation
[*] General improvements
[*] The save game can be continued on full release[/list]
Exactly, once [b]Laika: Aged Through Blood[/b] releases on October 19 and you played the demo, you can continue where the demo ended.

We really hope you enjoy playing our demo! If you're having a good time, do us a favor and click on "Follow" as well as on "Add To Your Wishlist" and leave your feedback in the Steam Community Hub. That would really help us a lot. ❤️

And as you are in the western-inspired shooting mood already, you should also take a look at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2429240/Soulslinger_Envoy_of_Death/][b]Soulslinger: Envoy of Death[/b][/url] demo. Enjoy!

Happy Steam Next Fest to all of you!
Brainwash Gang
